_comment: Client tool definitions for the ElevenLabs agent that plays Study Tree. Paste each object into Tools > Add tool > Edit as JSON in the ElevenLabs dashboard. Names and parameter ids must match exactly: the browser looks tools up by name and reads arguments by id.

tools.name: get_board
tools.description: Read the current board: the seed question, every node with its id, label and kind, plus moves remaining and whose turn it is. Call this before making a move so you know which node ids exist.

tools.name: get_node_state
tools.description: Read one node in detail: its label, kind, parent, children, and whether it is selected. Omit nodeId to inspect whatever the human currently has selected on the canvas, which is how to answer questions about 'this node'.

parameters.description: A node id such as n4, or the node's exact label. Leave empty to inspect the node the human has selected.

tools.name: plant
tools.description: Plant the root node of the learning tree. Only valid as the very first move, when the board is empty. Use the seed question as the label.

parameters.description: Label for the root node, usually the learning question itself.

tools.name: branch
tools.description: Expand an existing node with a new child node. This is the main way to grow the tree toward the win condition of five or more nodes.

parameters.description: The id (for example n2) or the exact label of the node to branch from. Call get_board first to see valid ids.
A short label for the new node, two to five words.
Exactly one of: concept, resource, skill, gap. Use concept for an idea or topic, resource for a book or course, skill for an ability to practise, gap for something still unknown.

tools.name: prune
tools.description: Remove a node and all of its descendants. Use this to cut an off-topic or duplicated branch. The root cannot be pruned.

parameters.description: The id (for example n2) or the exact label of the node to remove.

tools.name: mark_gap
tools.description: Flag a node as an open knowledge gap. Any remaining gap node blocks the win, so only mark what genuinely needs filling.

parameters.description: The id (for example n2) or the exact label of the node to flag.

tools.name: mark_clear
tools.description: Clear the gap flag on a node once it has been addressed, turning it back into a concept. Clearing every gap is required to win.

parameters.description: The id (for example n2) or the exact label of the gap node to clear.
